verdict.rationale: Smooth is driven by plain-language task instructions. Examples include `smooth_client.run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight...")`, asking Claude Code or other agents to do something on the web so they call Smooth automatically, and data extraction where you 'just describe what you want'. A hands-on user reports writing a complex prompt and getting good results. Missing for 10: a documented standalone conversational interface (natural-language use currently goes through SDK code or a host agent), and independent evidence of instruction-following reliability beyond one anecdote.
